_about: Shipping costs, from PostNL 'Landenoverzicht zakelijke tarieven (bus)pakjes, per januari 2026',
page 5: Klein Pakket met track & trace (sources/def-landentarieven-zakelijk-2026.pdf).
rates: euro per parcel for the weight bands in 'bands' (upper limits in grams: 0-250, 250-500, 500-1000, 1000-2000).
A piece counts as gramsPerPiece (about 500 g with packaging, plus a margin); a parcel holds at most maxParcelGrams,
so 1 piece is charged at 500-1000 g, 2-3 pieces at 1000-2000 g, and 4 or more go in several parcels.
Countries not named get 'otherEurope' (the codes in 'europe') or 'otherWorld'. 'aliases' use another country's rates.
'exclude': never offered (Russia and Belarus: EU sanctions). Places without postal delivery (Antarctica, …) never are.
NL (domestic, not in the PDF): one price per parcel, given by Uri.
surcharge: added to the shipping cost, as a percentage of the value of the pieces.

US.label: including US import duties and fees
